findings.evidence: `def relabelKernel (S : GroupExtension N E G) {N' : Type*} [Group N'] (e : N' ≃* N)` at line 63 — signature mentions neither `f` nor `Function.Surjective`; the file header at line 10 reads `# Group extensions from surjective homomorphisms`.
findings.fix: Move `relabelKernel` and its two simp lemmas to a general module (e.g. new `TauCeti/GroupTheory/GroupExtension/Basic.lean`, importing only `Mathlib.GroupTheory.GroupExtension.Defs`) and import that from `Of/Surjective.lean`, which then keeps only `ofSurjective`, `ofMulEquivKer` and their equations.
findings.issue: `relabelKernel` (line 63) and its lemmas `relabelKernel_inl_apply` (78) / `relabelKernel_rightHom` (84) take an arbitrary `S : GroupExtension N E G` and `e : N' ≃* N` — no surjectivity anywhere — yet sit in a module titled `Of/Surjective.lean` ("Group extensions from surjective homomorphisms"), under a directory the PR organizes around constructions *of* an extension from input data. A reader wanting to relabel the kernel of, say, a `FactorSet.groupExtension` will not look here, and must import the surjection module to get it.

summary: The rename is clean: old path deleted, no shim, all in-repo imports and doc pointers updated, imports narrow. But the general kernel-relabelling operation is buried in a file about surjective homomorphisms.
